description:
Get a filtered option chain suitable for spread evaluation.

Returns a markdown table of surviving contracts with one row per leg.
Header line carries the underlying price and the active filter constants.

days_to_expiration.description: Maximum days to expiration to include (default 21).

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

strike_count.description:
Approximate total strikes returned, centered on ATM
(default 20).

symbol.description:
Underlying ticker (equity or ETF). For index options use the
$-prefix form: $SPX, $NDX, $RUT.

name: schwab_get_option_chain
title: Option chain
